ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter BYOVD — vulnerable driver drop + kernel service registration
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's signature defense-evasion utility EDRKillShifter, which drops a legitimately-signed but vulnerable driver to a user-writable path and registers it as a kernel-mode service to terminate EDR/AV processes before encryption. The user-path .sys drop immediately followed by a kernel-driver service pointing at that file is highly specific to this loader and not seen in benign driver installs.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Services where Services.service_type="kernel_driver" (Services.service_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Services.service_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Services.service_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Services.service_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Services.service_path="*\\Downloads\\*") Services.service_path="*.sys" by Services.dest Services.service_name Services.service_path Services.start_mode Services.user 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Services)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\Users\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Public\"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName endswith ".sys"
| where FolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"          // exclude machine/SYSTEM context
| project DriverWriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
          DriverFile = FileName, DropProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RegistryKey has @"\Services\"
| where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
| where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
| where RegistryValueData has_any (UserWritable)
| join kind=inner DriverDrops on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (DriverWriteTime .. DriverWriteTime + 10m)   // drop->service-register within 10m
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DriverFile, DriverPath, ServiceKey = RegistryKey,
          ImagePath = RegistryValueData, DropProc, DropCmd, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4697 or EventID == 7045          // service installed (Security / System log)
| extend SvcPath = coalesce(ServiceFileName, ServiceName)
| where SvcPath endswith ".sys"
| where SvcPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Public\")
| where (isempty(ServiceType) or ServiceType has_any ("0x1","kernel"))   // kernel-mode driver
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ServiceName, ServiceFileName = SvcPath, ServiceType, SubjectUserName, Account
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: RansomHub EDRKillShifter BYOVD Kernel Driver Service Install
id: 7c3f2a91-4d6e-4b2a-9f0c-1ab5e8d3c910
status: experimental
description: Detects registration of a kernel-mode service whose image is a .sys driver written to a user-writable path, matching RansomHub's EDRKillShifter BYOVD EDR-killer.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1543.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system
detection:
  selection:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
    ImagePath|endswith: '.sys'
    ImagePath|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Rare third-party kernel drivers staged in user-writable directories
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\Users\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Public\* OR *\Downloads\*)) @TargetFilename:(*.sys OR *.SYS) -@Image:(*\System32\* OR *\system32\* OR *\SysWOW64\* OR *\syswow64\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i
| TargetFileName=/\\(Users|Temp|ProgramData|Public|Downloads)\\/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\.exe$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count(as=writes))
ucs.rationale: EDRKillShifter is a RansomHub-bespoke tool (CISA AA24-242A) that abuses BYOVD: it self-extracts a signed-but-vulnerable driver to a user-writable directory at runtime and loads it as a kernel service to blind EDR. ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub encryptor mass file-rename fan-out with README ransom-note drop
ucs.description: Catches the RansomHub payload at the impact stage: a single non-system process rewriting/renaming hundreds of files across directories within minutes (intermittent encryption + random extension) while simultaneously dropping the RansomHub README ransom note. The fan-out paired with the actor's note-naming convention isolates RansomHub from benign bulk file operations.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count dc(Filesystem.file_path) as path_count values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_names min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("modified","renamed","created") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.process_guid _time span=5m 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` 
| where path_count > 200          /* P99 bulk-modify baseline ~150; encryptor touches 100s/min */ 
| eval note_present=if(match(mvjoin(file_names,"|"),"(?i)(README|How.?To.?(Restore|Decrypt)|RansomHub)"),1,0) 
| where note_present=1 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutThreshold = 200;     // 200 = empirical bulk-modify ceiling; encryptor exceeds in minutes (P99 benign ~150)
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileModified","FileCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"            // exclude machine/SYSTEM
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\Windows\"          // strip OS/update churn
| summarize FileCount = dcount(FolderPath),
            NoteSeen = countif(FileName matches regex @"(?i)(README|How[_ ]?To[_ ]?(Restore|Decrypt)|RansomHub)"),
            DistinctExt = dcount(tostring(extract(@"\.([A-Za-z0-9]{4,12})$", 1, FileName))),
            SampleFile = any(FileName),
            arg_min(Timestamp, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where FileCount > FanoutThreshold and NoteSeen > 0
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessId,
          FileCount, NoteSeen, DistinctExt, SampleFile, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutThreshold = 200;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventType in ("FileModified","FileRenamed","FileCreated")
| where isnotempty(ActingProcessName)
| where ActingProcessName !has @"\Windows\"
| summarize FileCount = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            NoteSeen = countif(TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)(README|How[_ ]?To[_ ]?(Restore|Decrypt)|RansomHub)"),
            SampleFile = any(TargetFileName),
            CmdLine = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FileCount > FanoutThreshold and NoteSeen > 0
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessId, FileCount, NoteSeen, SampleFile, CmdLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*README* OR *readme* OR *How?To?Restore* OR *How?To?Decrypt* OR *RansomHub* OR *ransomhub*) -@Image:(*\Windows\* OR *\windows\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| ContextImageFileName=/\.exe$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\Windows\\/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextProcessId, ContextImageFileName], function={ count(as=fileWrites) | collect([TargetFileName]) })
| fileWrites > 200
| TargetFileName=/(README|How.?To.?(Restore|Decrypt)|RansomHub)/i
